name: diary-cards
description: View your Obsidian daily notes as cards

scripts.install-vault: npm run build && mkdir -p "$VAULT/.obsidian/plugins/diary-cards" && cp main.js manifest.json styles.css "$VAULT/.obsidian/plugins/diary-cards/"
scripts.test: node esbuild.config.mjs test && node test/dist/summary.test.js && node test/dist/dates.test.js && node test/dist/photos.test.js
scripts.version: node version-bump.mjs && git add manifest.json versions.json
